title: CAS Loop: Double Until Even
prompt: ISO C11. Implement `void double_until_even(atomic_int *v)` — repeatedly double `*v` using a compare-exchange loop until the new value is even. Every doubling must go through one atomic CAS (no plain `*v = *v * 2`).

tests.name: doubles odd values once
tests.hint: 3 doubled is 6 — even, so exactly one CAS round.

tests.name: already even stays
tests.hint: 4 is even but the contract is double-then-check: 8, still one round.

tests.name: zero stays zero
tests.hint: 0 doubled is 0 — the loop must terminate on the zero fixed point.
